description: This file declares a function for creating a new 'load configs' command handler for the 'cuttlefish' project. It includes necessary headers and forward declares the creation function, along with a brief description of its purpose related to loading and managing 'cuttlefish' instances based on JSON configurations.

methods.name: NewLoadConfigsCommand
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a CvdCommandHandler that manages loading, translation, and creation of cuttlefish instances based on input JSON configurations, utilizing provided executor and instance manager.
